proposed_function: Stabilizes the interaction with RNA by reducing the dissociation rate (off-rate) of the Mmi1 YTH domain-RNA complex.
evidence: When we analyzed RNA binding by EMSA using this construct, a stable RNA-protein complex was visualized as a better-defined band on the gel (Fig. 1B, right).
curator_note: Exact positions given (residues 282-326 defined as USR); experimental binding to RNA confirmed via EMSA and kinetics.
